title.zh: Renzo回应MetaMask安全事件：Basis风险与流动性可完全链上验证，目前提现队列中仅有214.75枚stETH
title.en: Renzo回应MetaMask安全事件：Basis风险与流动性可完全链上验证，目前提现队列中仅有214.75枚stETH

current_state.zh: Renzo said its Basis product and ezETH remain unaffected by the MetaMask infrastructure security incident, with just 214.75 stETH (0.5%) in its withdrawal queue, as MetaMask proactively exits impacted validators from its non-custodial staking service.
current_state.en: Renzo said its Basis product and ezETH remain unaffected by the MetaMask infrastructure security incident, with just 214.75 stETH (0.5%) in its withdrawal queue, as MetaMask proactively exits impacted validators from its non-custodial staking service.
